consequence.statement: The new flag is optional and does not affect environments that do not set it; environments that adopt it gain the ability to selectively copy annotations from Ingress resources to Certificate objects.

assertion.statement: The ingress-shim component adds a new command-line flag --extra-certificate-annotations that allows specifying annotation keys to be copied from Ingress-like resources to resulting Certificate objects.
